# Neuroimaging in ABCD

Over the ABCD study's ten-year period of data collection, participants are scheduled to undergo neuroimaging every 2 years. The details of this neuroimaging are described in detail in a guide by Hagler et al. (@FZB3URNJ#Hagler_Etal_2019). This chapter provides an easier-to-digest summary of that information.

## Types of imaging data collected

Three major types of imaging data are provided by the NDA:

- structural MRI (sMRI)
- diffusion MRI (dMRI)
- functional MRI (fMRI)
    - task-related analysis of functional MRI (task-fMRI)
    - functional connectivity analysis of resting-state fMRI (rsfMRI)


DTI measures are provided for subcortical regions, cortical regions, and major white matter fiber tracts.
The analyses in this project are only concerned with white matter structures, which are present in the following ROIs:

1. Fiber tracts automatically labeled by AtlasTrack [Hagler] (supplementary table 6 of Hagler 2019 file 1)

E.g.:

* Element: dmdtifp1_1
* Name: Average fractional anisotropy within DTI atlas tract right fornix
* Aliases: dmri_dti.full.fa_fiber.at_fx.rh, dmri_dtifullfa_fiberat_fxrh


2. Subcortical regions labeled by automated segmentation [Fischl] (supplementary table 1 of Hagler 2019 file 1)

E.g.:

* Element: dmdtifp1_211
* Name: Average fractional anisotropy within ASEG ROI left-cerebral-white-matter
* Aliases: dmri_dti.full.md_subcort.aseg_cerebellum.white.matter.lh, dmri_dtifullmd_subcortaseg_cerebellumwhitematterlh


3. Regions of white matter sub-adjacent to cortical regions defined by anatomical parcellation [Desikan] (supplementary table 2 of Hagler 2019 file 1)

E.g.:

* Element: dmdtifp1_343
* Name: Average fractional anisotropy within parcellation of sub-adjacent white matter associated with cortical ROI left-medial orbito frontal
* Aliases: dmri_dti.full.fa.wm_cort.desikan_medialorbitofrontal.lh, dmri_dtifullfawm_cortdesikan_medialorbitofrontallh

Detailed lists of the ROIs are present in Supplementary File 2 of @hagler_image_2019.
